authority: Newly closed source and explicit human authoring constraints only.

issues.issue: The source writes equalities for angular ratios that require the small-angle approximation.
issues.treatment: Keep every original formula, equation number and token order; explicitly state small angles, radians and matching length units, and explain angular rather than physical-object enlargement.

issues.issue: The source comparison distance is not a universal near point or personal comfort distance.
issues.treatment: Retain the original d0 token and value as a conventional unaided comparison distance.

issues.issue: The substitution prose literally uses the standalone phi2 token, whereas the preceding angular-ratio equation names the unaided angle without that subscript.
issues.treatment: Preserve the exact standalone token and the following written calculation; explicitly flag the undefined linkage in both candidate languages, with no replacement and no erratum registration.

issues.issue: Parallel bundles allow relaxed viewing only for a suitable eye focusing state; moving inside the focal plane changes the accommodation demand.
issues.treatment: Define focusing adjustment plainly, distinguish same-point parallel bundles from different-point directions, and condition retinal focus on an eye able to focus distant objects without extra adjustment.

issues.issue: The source's common focal-length range and small-diameter-only claim are not universal design laws.
issues.treatment: Keep the original common range and practical difficulty, explicitly qualify them, and mention surface curvature and material rather than making diameter the sole cause.

issues.issue: The source simple microscope arrangement is not every real microscope design.
issues.treatment: Explain the objective/intermediate-image/eyepiece/eye causal sequence, preserve A/A1/A2 exactly and in order, qualify the simple thin-lens and focal-plane arrangement, and clarify unresolved detail rather than literal universal retinal overlap.

issues.issue: Millimeter divisions describe scale spacing, not the total physical ruler length or the length of the imaged segment. The given object distance and screen-image length alone do not establish the requested focal length.
issues.treatment: Retain d=1.25 cm and l=2.4 cm exactly, keep the question as printed, and do not invent a ruler length, select a single division as the object, change units or provide an answer.

issues.issue: The written prompt does not explicitly name which focal point or placement side.
issues.treatment: Translate the prompt faithfully without choosing an unprinted side, supplying a construction or resolving the answer.

issues.issue: The text references historical Figure 185, but the supplied n80 figure template lists only Figures 188 through 192.
issues.treatment: Keep the reference; no shared figure is presumed reusable or approved, and no source image is opened or modern asset authored.

issues.issue: The existing full-edition validator treats title, exercise group and displayed exercise figure labels as immutable identity fields.
issues.treatment: Author the explicitly requested modern localized titles and captions in candidates only, retaining printed_title, source snapshots, numbering, group_id and all source/figure bindings. Do not modify tools or claim finalize acceptance.
